incident-bot: [INCIDENT] P1 — gen-prod inference latency spike detected (error-rate rising). Auto-paging @raj @sarah at 2026-03-12T09:02:25Z :rotating_light:

mike: saw the page, joining. grabbing traces and dashboard now.

sarah: i'm on model infra. initial look shows KV cache misses spiking on node group gpu-a. errors: OOM-ish logs + timeout loops. hitting model-serving-01 logs.

raj: reassigning to me for oncall. mike, can you paste the error lines? i pulled up latest traces.

mike: paste: ```
2026-03-12T09:01:58Z model-serving-01 stderr: RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating 256MB
2026-03-12T09:02:03Z proxy-rt: request id=abc123 latency=2.9s status=504
```

emily: FYI customer-impact: a handful of requests in chat-prod returned 504 between 09:01 and 09:08. Estimated affected users ~120, predominantly EU region. Customer success notified for major accounts.

sarah: looks like a regression from yesterday's runtime kernel switch. GPU mem thresholds reduced in that rollout. will try revert to previous kernel at the nodegroup level.

raj: agree. mike, can you put model-serving-01 into maintenance and drain traffic? use command below: 
```
./infractl drain-node --name model-serving-01 --reason "post-deploy kernel regression"
```

mike: running drain now. routing fallback to gen-prod-ssd pool.

incident-bot: ACTION: Draining model-serving-01 initiated by mike at 2026-03-12T09:06:12Z.

pranav: i'm taking heap/profile dump and KV metrics. will upload to the incident doc.

mike: traffic drained and error rate dropping. latency back to baseline in ~2m.

raj: marking incident as mitigated. moving to post-incident review workflow.

sarah: root cause note for RCA: recent runtime kernel change introduced more aggressive memory prefetch behavior; under cold cache patterns this caused transient OOMs and request timeouts.

emily: scheduling postmortem: who can own writeup? prefer someone from infra + runtime. raj or sarah?

raj: i'll draft the postmortem timeline (detected -> mitigated -> revert), put initial doc in docs/postmortems/incident-1782103345.md and request peer review.

mike: raj, i'll add operation timeline and command snippets. sarah add kernel change diff and config. pranav add metrics + heap dump link. emily, can you coordinate CS communications and add customer impact summary?

emily: yep, i'll add impact section and a note on accounts contacted.

incident-bot: REMINDER: postmortem draft due in 48h. Set reviewer tags: @sarah, @mike, @pranav.

raj: drafting now. planned sections: timeline, impact, contributing factors, remediation, action items, follow-ups. Proposed owners:
- Author: raj
- Reviewers: sarah, mike, pranav
- Sign-off: infra lead (teresa) + product lead (zach)

pranav: propose immediate remediation: revert kernel change on the next deploy pipeline and add a canary that exercises cold-cache path. Also add an alert for KV cache miss ratio + OOM error rate.

mike: agree. action items (short):
1) revert kernel change in canary (OWNER: sarah, ETA: 24h)
2) add KV cache miss alert (OWNER: pranav, ETA: 72h)
3) implement draining playbook improvements (OWNER: mike, ETA: 1 week)
4) customer communication follow-up (OWNER: emily, ETA: 48h)

sarah: noted. i'll open the rollback PR and include the config revert and a test that simulates cold-cache.

emily: scheduling the postmortem meeting for 2026-03-13 15:00 UTC. invite sent to infra, runtime, product, cs.

raj: once draft is up i'll ping reviewers here. plan to include a short timeline with exact timestamps and traffic numbers.
